beats.say: Auto sales for September twenty twenty six are out, and they close the quarter. So we ranked eleven listed automakers on one number: how fast their sales in India grew from July to September, using only their own filings. Maruti won September. It didn't win the quarter. And the fastest grower has one of the weaker Moat Scores on the list.

beats.say: Tractors tell a different story. Escorts sold almost exactly as many as last year. For September's fall, it cites a high base, a later festive season, a patchy monsoon and lower kharif sowing. Its construction equipment, meanwhile, grew fifty four percent.
